changes: Found and fixed the real cause of the Casino Pot distributing three times in one day, well outside its schedule: the admin "Close period" button was always force-closing the current, still-open period, not just genuinely overdue ones. That capability is now removed entirely — the current period can never be closed early by this button again.
Removed the redundant "Rules" hub screen — it opened the exact same info every individual game's own Rules button already shows.
Blackjack, Baccarat, War, and Slots can now take a custom bet amount by tapping the chip, matching every other game.
